Intrauterine Insemination (IUI) is a safe, simple, and effective fertility treatment designed to help couples improve their chances of conception. At Dr. Patil's IVF & Fertility Clinic – Goregaon, IUI is performed with precision and personalized care to support your journey toward parenthood.

During the IUI procedure, specially prepared and concentrated sperm are carefully placed directly into the uterus around the time of ovulation. This process allows the sperm to reach the egg more easily, increasing the chances of successful fertilization. IUI is commonly recommended for couples facing unexplained infertility, mild male factor infertility, ovulation-related issues, or cervical problems.

The treatment is minimally invasive, usually painless, and does not require hospital admission, making it a comfortable option for many patients. With expert evaluation, advanced techniques, and compassionate guidance, IUI can be an ideal first step toward achieving pregnancy.
